Keep BOTH original figures from input 1 exactly recognizable and unchanged in design: every cuboid shape, protruding eye, hair block, pixel pattern, printed color, limb length, clothing seam, shoe shape, pose, original viewing angle, relative height, relative placement and the gap between them. Reframe the full pair centered as one group horizontally and vertically, with their combined silhouette occupying approximately 78% of frame height, balanced gray margins on both sides, and comfortable clear space above Rick's hair and below both pairs of feet. Keep the complete figures visible and grounded with soft contact shadows. Seamlessly extend gray background as needed.
No hands, extra objects, extra characters, text, logos, watermarks, borders, blurred duplicate backgrounds or stretched edges. Only deliver the edited duo photograph.
